meta.title: Make benchmarks only run with release builds
meta.body_summary: Enforce that benchmarks only run with release/optimized builds by adding compile-time checks and updating CI/justfile to use release profile.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot enforced release-only benchmarks via conditional compilation, but struggled with clippy/fmt fixes and final rebase; after multiple review rounds, closed to be restarted.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 145 changed lines across 6 files, this is a small build configuration change. As a small-step PR, it was closed—not merged—due to persistent CI issues and inability to rebase after 999 hours.

review_details.concern_detail: Initial compile_error! in benchmarks.rs broke `just clippy debug`. Reviewers requested checking optimization level instead of debug_assertions, and the agent struggled with conditional compilation placement and merge conflicts with upstream changes (PR #703).
review_details.performance_claim: Enforcing release-only benchmarks ensures consistent performance data for regression testing.
review_details.rejection_signals: Copilot unable to rebase after prolonged merge conflict resolution; maintainers closed to restart.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot implemented compile-time benchmark restriction but failed to resolve complex merge conflicts and rebase after multiple CI feedback rounds, leading to PR abandonment.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewers ludfjig, simongdavies, jsturtevant, syntactically inspected the conditional compilation logic and suggested improvements (e.g., using optimization level instead of debug_assertions).
detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Actions CI caught clippy and formatting errors repeatedly, prompting multiple fix commits.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: The PR went through many iterations; final state was not merged, and clear reproduction steps for the final enforcement were not provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After multiple rounds of fixing clippy and rebasing, maintainers chose to close the PR and plan a fresh start due to merge conflicts.

core_change_summary.description: Added compile-time checks in hyperlight_host benchmarks to only allow compilation with optimized builds (opt-level 1+), removed debug target from just bench/bench-ci commands, updated CI workflows to use release-only bench commands, and adjusted documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Workflow and doc updates are secondary to the core Rust enforcement logic.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added compile_error! on debug_assertions, updated justfile to hardcode release profile, updated workflows and docs.
Review feedback: changed from debug_assertions to opt-level check via build.rs setting cfg flags; added compile-time conditional compilation.
Multiple iterations to fix clippy errors by excluding benchmarks in debug mode, adjusting conditional compilation placement (file-level vs item-level).
Final commits attempted to rebase onto main and resolve conflicts with PR #703 workflow changes, but rebase failed and PR closed.

review_signals.summary: just clippy failed in GitHub Actions; Copilot fixed by modifying clippy command and later by restructuring conditional compilation.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot fixed across multiple commits (6236f65, 44e925c, etc.)

review_signals.summary: Suggested checking opt level instead of debug_assertions to allow release builds with debug symbols.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot adopted opt-level check via build.rs.

review_signals.summary: Requested to fix formatting and clippy errors; also suggested using #![cfg(optimized_build)] at top of file.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot applied fixes in commits cbd9467 and subsequent.

review_signals.summary: Flagged that workflow changes didn't align with PR #703 and suggested using not(optimized_build) instead of unoptimized_build.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot fixed workflow flags and simplified cfg condition in commit f10e216.

review_signals.summary: Stated that Copilot cannot rebase, and the PR must be closed and restarted.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with compile_error! and justfile changes.
simongdavies reported `just clippy` failure; Copilot fixed by modifying clippy command.
ludfjig reviewed and requested opt-level check; Copilot switched to build.rs cfg flags.
Multiple rounds of clippy/fmt fixes and back-and-forth about cfg attribute placement.
jsturtevant requested CHANGES_REQUESTED to fix fmt and align with PR #703; Copilot applied fixes.
syntactically flagged workflow incompatibilities and redundant cfg; Copilot adjusted.
simongdavies asked to rebase onto main and resolve conflicts; Copilot attempted but ultimately failed, recommended restarting.
jsturtevant closed PR to restart due to rebase inability.
